}}'''Machan''' is [[Warder]] to an unknown [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]].

==Activities==
[[Arinvar]] speaks to the [[Salidar Six]] about a group of mounted men approaching [[Salidar]] based on reports made by Machan.  This group is [[Gareth Bryne]] and his men who had followed [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]] and [[Logain Ablar]].
